faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before your first session
faq.q1: Do I need previous meditation experience?
faq.a1: No. Sessions are accessible to everyone, regardless of experience. You only need to arrive with an open mind and willingness for the experience, to transform limiting patterns.
faq.q2: What should I bring to the session?
faq.a2: Comfortable clothing, a water bottle, your yoga mat, and a blanket. We provide a pillow, blinders, and headphones.
faq.q3: How often should I have sessions?
faq.a3: For more consistent results, I recommend starting with one session per month, then spacing them according to your needs. Many clients enjoy a monthly session as a maintenance practice.
faq.a4: Breathwork has contraindications. Please inform about medical conditions (pregnancy, heart conditions, epilepsy, and asthma) before the session. We always seek to adapt the work in the session for each person.
faq.q5: Can I combine these therapies with medical treatments?
faq.a5: Yes. These therapies are complementary and do not replace medical treatment. Many health professionals attend and recommend breathwork as a therapeutic complement.
faq.a6: Breathwork sessions are in-person and you can take therapeutic sessions online for better results as a complement to these 2 therapies.
faq.a7: You can cancel or reschedule with 24 hours notice at no cost. There are no refunds but you can reschedule to the next available date.
